name: Mars Rover
description: Chunky six-wheel Mars exploration rover: ivory chamfered hull, slate fenders, orange hubs and panels, dark windshield, amber headlights and cyan roof bar. Static display asset for the game test pad.
brief: User requested the rover from the approved Mars references and its integration/presentation in game. Matched vehicles.png, vehicles-hero.png and Mars hero: six fat treaded wheels, sloped windshield, broad chamfers, thick fenders, white/grey/orange blocking, roof cargo/antenna and restrained emissive strips. GPU views reviewed front/side/back; 7,252 tris, 4.4915m long x 2.63m tall x 2.433m wide, minY=0. Front tyre/fender surface clearance 0.023003m both sides; roof cargo contacts platform; axle/rim and windshield/frame joins measured. Intentional nested hub and body/detail overlaps; general overlap sampling partial. No driving, animation or interior requested. Pending destination collision/loading/lighting check.

metrics.partVolumeScope: Visible static closed mesh pairs, except alternates on different LOD levels; excludes intra-mesh intersections, motion, open surfaces and usable passage space. Positive overlap may be intentional.
metrics.openSurfaceScope: Visible static open surfaces sampled at their vertices against visible static closed solids, except alternates on different LOD levels; excludes open-vs-open pairs, motion, and any solid thinner than the sampled surface's facet spacing. Penetration within the contact tolerance is treated as intended contact, and penetration beyond it may still be intentional, as a fitting socketed into a shell is.

metrics.instanceabilitySummary: D (informational, not a QA verdict), set by 7 distinct materials (D at 7-12). Also: 48 geometries; 193 draw calls.
